title: Renew a National Parks annual pass
summary: This page provides information on renewing an eligible NSW National Parks annual pass.
intro:
Eligible NSW National Parks annual passes can be renewed up to 30 days before the pass expiry date.

You'll receive a reminder email from National Parks and Wildlife Service (NPWS) with a link to renew.

Annual passes are digital, which means you can use them straight away. You will not receive a physical pass to display in your vehicle.

If you have not received a renewal notice, call NPWS on 1300 072 757.

For more information, visit the NSW National Parks and Wildlife Service website.
